events.title: Patch Notes v0.1.2
events.summary: Patch Notes v0.1.2:Moved Rain level to 6 to create a better flow through the levels. Players reported getting stuck too soon.Adjusted level 6 so that there are more solutions/easier solutions to find.Fixed cross section air pockets not behaving correctly Added next level button to end level screen Updated wind effects: wind now also visible while building, and now has visual effect showing that the pieces block the wind. See below:Fix bugs with deleting materials Easier placement of raft pieces

events.title: We Are Part of GDoC Expo!
events.summary: We are proud to announce we are going to be part of Game Devs of Color Expo. Float Your Goat is made by a two-person studio, and the art you see comes from a Mexican woman's hands. Every raft, every goat, every rocky coastline, hand-drawn by her. GDoCExpo exists to spotlight creators of colour in games, and we're honoured to be counted among them.GDoCExpo brings together game creators from around the world for an online conference! events.title: Thank you to everyone at Rapture Games Colchester
events.summary: This weekend we had the pleasure of showing our demo in Rapture Games festival. We had an absolute blast seeing everyone play, laugh and solve the puzzles. We also got some great feedback from players, so expect some changes to the demo coming soon. One particular suggestion really caught our attention: adding clothing and accessories to the goat. It's something we are definitely considering. Thanks again to everyone for their continued support through this journey. Happy Floating! 🐐

events.title: Sneak Peak into Area 2: Tangled Tides
events.summary: Hello folks! As we delve deeper into the developing the final game, we thought we would share our latest achievement. We have finished setting up the second area of the game named Tangled Tides. This area is inspired by the Caribbean islands, featuring coral reefs, jungles and mangrove forests. This area also introduces new materials; rope and locks.Creating this area has inspired us to look back at Rocky Start and rethink some design choices. So expect a visual revamp to the demo coming soon!

events.title: We're in Flash Game Vibes 2026!
events.summary: Hey everyone! We are happy to announce we are joining Flash Game Vibes 2026! The event wants to celebrate games that have that 2000s browser game aesthetic which include both art and gameplay styles. We feel our game fits right in and are excited to be featuring along other cartoony and stylised games. Check out the event here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45942132/sale/FlashGameVibes2026

events.title: Patch Notes v 0.1.1
events.summary: Patch Notes v0.1.1:Controller support! Now supports menu navigation and gameplay with a controller, including the Steam Deck. Goat jumps off his rafts at the end of levels: Players found it a little confusing whether they completed a level or not, now the goat enthusiastically jumps off his raft to the next island if he manages to stay dry. Minor changes: Adjusted some level lengths, adjusted some level material amounts to allow for more freedom in builds.Stay dry!

events.title: Patch Notes v0.1.0
events.summary: Patch Notes v0.1.0:Help menu added: view examples of the different air pocket types, as well as revisit all the tutorials.Air pockets now appear no matter how many times a level is restarted (used to stop appearing sometimes)Air pockets now do not make the goat fly into space! (sorry if thats what you wanted)Fixed level timer timing down when the game was paused.Added small map tutorial.Fixed the flying goat:New help menu:Happy Floating!
